GET /me.title: Get Me Details
GET /me.abstract: Return the user ID and organization ID of the authenticated API caller.

GET /acls.title: Get User ACL
GET /acls.abstract: Return the ad accounts and roles accessible to the authenticated API caller.

GET /orgs/{id}.title: Get Org by ID

POST /ad-accounts.title: Create Ad Accounts
POST /ad-accounts.abstract: Create a new ad account under a specified organization.

GET /ad-accounts/{id}.title: Get Ad Account by ID
GET /ad-accounts/{id}.abstract: Retrieve the full details of a specific ad account by its ID.

PUT /ad-accounts/{id}.title: Update Ad Accounts
PUT /ad-accounts/{id}.abstract: Update an ad account’s name or delegations.

GET /advertiser-resources.title: Get Advertiser Resources
GET /advertiser-resources.abstract: Retrieve the advertiser resources available to your organization, filtered by resource type.

GET /search/apps.title: Search for Apps
GET /search/apps.abstract: Search the App Store for apps matching the supplied criteria and return app details.

GET /apps/{adamId}.title: Get App Details by Adam ID
GET /apps/{adamId}.abstract: Retrieve application details for a specific Adam ID.

POST /metadata/apps/supported-languages/.title: Query Supported App Languages
POST /metadata/apps/supported-languages/.abstract: Query countries and regions to discover the ad-supported languages available in each market.

POST /eligibilities/apps/query.title: Check App Eligibility
POST /eligibilities/apps/query.abstract: Check whether apps are eligible to run on certain Apple Ads placements and in specific countries or regions.

POST /rejection-reasons/apps/query.title: Query Rejection Reasons
POST /rejection-reasons/apps/query.abstract: Query ad creative rejection reasons for apps and return why each ad creative failed approval.

GET /rejection-reasons/apps/{rejectionRe.title: Get Rejection Reasons
GET /rejection-reasons/apps/{rejectionRe.abstract: Retrieve the details of an ad creative rejection reason by ID.

POST /business-brands/query.title: Query Brands
POST /business-brands/query.abstract: Retrieve a paginated list of brands using filters and sorting.

GET /business-brands/{id}.title: Get Brand by ID
GET /business-brands/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single brand by its unique identifier.

POST /business-categories/query.title: Query Business Categories
POST /business-categories/query.abstract: Retrieve a paginated list of business categories using filters and sorting.

GET /business-categories/{id}.title: Get Business Category
GET /business-categories/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single business category by its identifier.

POST /rejection-reasons/business-brands/.title: Query Rejection Reasons for Brands
POST /rejection-reasons/business-brands/.abstract: Query paginated policy assignment rejection reason details.

POST /location-groups.title: Create Location Group
POST /location-groups.abstract: Create a named group of locations for geographic targeting.

POST /location-groups/query.title: Query Location Groups
POST /location-groups/query.abstract: Retrieve a paginated list of location groups using filters and sorting.

GET /location-groups/{id}.title: Get Location Group
GET /location-groups/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single location group by its unique identifier.

PUT /location-groups/{id}.title: Update Location Group
PUT /location-groups/{id}.abstract: Update an existing location group’s name, rules, or location membership.

DELETE /location-groups/{id}.title: Delete Location Group
DELETE /location-groups/{id}.abstract: Delete a location group by its unique identifier.

POST /locations/query.title: Query for Locations
POST /locations/query.abstract: Retrieve a paginated list of business locations using filters and sorting.

GET /locations/{id}.title: Get a Location
GET /locations/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single business location by its unique identifier.

POST /campaigns.title: Create a Campaign
POST /campaigns.abstract: Create a new advertising campaign with a promoted object, budget, targeting, and bid strategy configuration.

POST /campaigns/query.title: Query Campaigns
POST /campaigns/query.abstract: Query campaigns using filters, sorting, and pagination.

GET /campaigns/{id}.title: Get a Campaign
GET /campaigns/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single campaign by its unique identifier.

PUT /campaigns/{id}.title: Update a Campaign
PUT /campaigns/{id}.abstract: Update a campaign’s name, status, budget, targeting, or bid strategy.

DELETE /campaigns/{id}.title: Delete a Campaign
DELETE /campaigns/{id}.abstract: Soft-delete a campaign by its unique identifier, cascading to its ad groups, keywords, and ads.

GET /campaigns/{id}/legacy-app-limited-s.title: Get Legacy App Limited Status Reason Details
GET /campaigns/{id}/legacy-app-limited-s.abstract: Return a map of country or region codes to their associated limited-status reason for legacy app campaigns.

POST /adgroups.title: Create an Ad Group
POST /adgroups.abstract: Create a new ad group within a campaign, defining targeting, bid strategy, and scheduling for a set of ads.

POST /adgroups/query.title: Query Ad Groups
POST /adgroups/query.abstract: Query ad groups using filters, sorting, and pagination.

GET /adgroups/{id}.title: Get an Ad Group
GET /adgroups/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single ad group by its unique identifier.

PUT /adgroups/{id}.title: Update an Ad Group
PUT /adgroups/{id}.abstract: Update an existing ad group’s name, status, bid strategy, targeting, or scheduling.

DELETE /adgroups/{id}.title: Delete an Ad Group
DELETE /adgroups/{id}.abstract: Soft-delete an ad group by its unique identifier, along with all ads and keywords associated with it.

POST /search/geo.title: Query Geo Locations
POST /search/geo.abstract: Search for geographic locations by entity type and ID for use in ad group geo targeting.

GET /search/geo.title: Search Geo Locations
GET /search/geo.abstract: Search for geographic locations for use in ad group geo targeting.

POST /keywords.title: Create a Keyword
POST /keywords.abstract: Create a new keyword in an ad group, setting the match type and optional bid amount.

POST /keywords/query.title: Query Keywords
POST /keywords/query.abstract: Query keywords using structured filters, sorting, and pagination.

GET /keywords/{id}.title: Get a Keyword
GET /keywords/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single keyword by its unique identifier.

PUT /keywords/{id}.title: Update a Keyword
PUT /keywords/{id}.abstract: Update a keyword’s bid amount or status to optimize spend and control delivery for that term.

DELETE /keywords/{id}.title: Delete a Keyword
DELETE /keywords/{id}.abstract: Soft-delete a keyword by ID, setting its deleted field to true and stopping bids on that term.

POST /negative-keywords.abstract: Create a negative keyword at the campaign or ad group level to prevent ads from showing for unwanted search terms.

POST /negative-keywords/query.abstract: Query negative keywords using structured filters, sorting, and pagination.

GET /negative-keywords/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single negative keyword by its unique identifier.

DELETE /negative-keywords/{id}.title: Delete a Negative Keyword
DELETE /negative-keywords/{id}.abstract: Soft-delete a negative keyword by ID.

POST /ads.title: Create an Ad
POST /ads.abstract: Creates a new ad that links an ad creative to an ad group for delivery.

POST /ads/query.title: Query Ads
POST /ads/query.abstract: Searches and filters ads using structured query criteria including field filters, sorting, and pagination.

GET /ads/{id}.title: Get an Ad
GET /ads/{id}.abstract: Retrieves a single ad by its unique identifier.

PUT /ads/{id}.title: Update an Ad
PUT /ads/{id}.abstract: Updates the name or status of an existing ad by its unique identifier.

DELETE /ads/{id}.title: Delete an Ad
DELETE /ads/{id}.abstract: Soft-deletes an ad by its unique identifier, stopping delivery and removing it from active results.

POST /creatives.title: Create an Ad Creative
POST /creatives.abstract: Add a new ad creative that defines the visual presentation and tap destination for an ad.

POST /creatives/query.title: Query Ad Creatives
POST /creatives/query.abstract: Retrieve ad creatives that match structured filter, sort, and pagination criteria.

PUT /creatives/{id}.title: Update an Ad Creative
PUT /creatives/{id}.abstract: Change an ad creative’s name or creative spec by its unique identifier.

DELETE /creatives/{id}.title: Delete an Ad Creative
DELETE /creatives/{id}.abstract: Remove an ad creative by its unique identifier.

POST /assets/upload.title: Upload Asset
POST /assets/upload.abstract: Upload a binary image file to create a new asset.

POST /assets/query.title: Query Assets
POST /assets/query.abstract: Retrieve a paginated list of creative assets using filters and sorting.

GET /assets/{id}.title: Get Asset
GET /assets/{id}.abstract: Retrieve a single asset by its UUID.

DELETE /assets/{id}.title: Delete Asset
DELETE /assets/{id}.abstract: Soft-delete an asset by its UUID.

POST /product-pages/query.title: Query Product Pages

GET /product-pages/{productPageId}.abstract: Retrieves a specific Product Page (DPP, CPP, or PPO) by its unique UUID.

POST /product-pages/locale-details/query.title: Query Product Page Locale Details
POST /product-pages/locale-details/query.abstract: Queries the localized content associated with a custom product page.

POST /apps/{adamId}/locale-details/query.title: Query App Locale Details
POST /apps/{adamId}/locale-details/query.abstract: Return the default product page locale details for an app identified by its adamId.

POST /keywords/bulk-create.title: Bulk Create Keywords
POST /keywords/bulk-create.abstract: Creates multiple keywords in a single request.

POST /keywords/bulk-update.title: Bulk Update Keywords
POST /keywords/bulk-update.abstract: Updates multiple keywords in a single request.

POST /negative-keywords/bulk-create.title: Bulk Create Negative Keywords
POST /negative-keywords/bulk-create.abstract: Create multiple negative keywords in a single request.

POST /negative-keywords/bulk-update.title: Bulk Update Negative Keywords
POST /negative-keywords/bulk-update.abstract: Update multiple negative keywords in a single request.

GET /shared-budgets/{id}.title: Get a Budget Order by ID
GET /shared-budgets/{id}.abstract: Retrieves a single budget order by its ID.

POST /shared-budgets.title: Create a Budget Order
POST /shared-budgets.abstract: Creates a budget order that can be assigned to campaigns within an ad account.

POST /shared-budgets/query.title: Query Budget Orders
POST /shared-budgets/query.abstract: Returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of budget orders.

PUT /shared-budgets/{id}.title: Update a Budget Order
PUT /shared-budgets/{id}.abstract: Updates mutable fields of an existing budget order by its unique identifier.

DELETE /shared-budgets/{id}.title: Delete a Budget Order
DELETE /shared-budgets/{id}.abstract: Soft-deletes a budget order by its unique identifier.

POST /reports/apps/campaigns/query.title: Campaigns Report
POST /reports/apps/campaigns/query.abstract: Retrieve performance metrics for campaigns broken down by optional dimensions such as country, device class, or storefront.

POST /reports/apps/adgroups/query.title: Ad Groups Report
POST /reports/apps/adgroups/query.abstract: Retrieve performance metrics for ad groups broken down by optional dimensions such as country, device class, or storefront.

POST /reports/apps/ads/query.title: Ads Report
POST /reports/apps/ads/query.abstract: Retrieve performance metrics for ads broken down by optional dimensions such as device class or country.

POST /reports/business-brands/ads/query.title: Ads Report (Brands)
POST /reports/business-brands/ads/query.abstract: Retrieve performance metrics for Apple Maps ads broken down by optional dimensions such as device class or country.

POST /reports/business-brands/keywords/q.title: Keywords Report (Brands)
POST /reports/business-brands/keywords/q.abstract: Retrieve performance metrics for Apple Maps keywords broken down by optional dimensions such as device class or country.

POST /reports/business-brands/searchterm.title: Search Terms Report (Brands)
POST /reports/business-brands/searchterm.abstract: Retrieve performance metrics for the actual search terms that triggered keyword matches in Apple Maps campaigns, broken down by optional dimensions.

POST /insights/apps/impression-share/que.title: Impression Share Query
POST /insights/apps/impression-share/que.abstract: Retrieve impression share data showing how often your ads appear relative to total eligible impressions for a given search term and country.

POST /change-history/query.title: Query Change History

GET /change-history/{detailId}.title: Get Change History Detail
